sentences.en: The restaurant uses a double-grill to cook skewers.
sentences.zh: 餐馆用双层烤架来烤串串。

sentences.en: She prefers the flavor from the double-grill over regular grills.
sentences.zh: 她觉得双层烤架烤出来的味道比普通烤架好。

sentences.en: The chef demonstrated how to use a double-grill on live TV.
sentences.zh: 厨师在电视上现场示范如何使用双层烤架。
